A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DAPS/LatentDAPS research. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–I support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original image-restoration, MRI, discretized-MNIST, and synthetic-distribution experiments, including quantitative results and ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The DAPS procedure, Gaussian approximation, MCMC alternatives, and latent and discrete extensions remain unchanged, including Algorithms 1–3.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same FFHQ, ImageNet, fastMRI, discretized-MNIST, and synthetic-data coverage, including the same text-conditioned and sparse-measurement scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in the reported comparisons is unchanged. DPnP already appears in v2 Figure 6(b); v3 adds its citation and textual baseline description.

E3.justification: Reported splits, preprocessing, metrics, measurement noise, sampling budgets, and testing procedures remain unchanged. The added DPnP source disclosure does not establish a protocol revision.

E4.justification: The efficiency sweeps, sampler and scheduling ablations, noise sensitivity, synthetic posterior analysis, phase-retrieval analyses, and qualitative examples are retained. Figure 10 reformats an existing analysis.

E5.justification: Mean/standard-deviation reporting, phase-retrieval sampling counts, seed information, and synthetic-experiment sample counts remain unchanged. No statistical tests or uncertainty procedures are added.

E6.justification: Tables 1–10 retain their numerical entries. Figure 6 already includes DPnP in v2, and Figure 10 retains Wasserstein distances of 0.057, 0.499, and 0.252 with the same findings.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, propositions, derivations, and Appendix D proofs remain unchanged. The final sentence of Proposition 1 moves across a page boundary without changing its meaning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about decoupled posterior sampling, correction of earlier errors, reconstruction quality and stability, and applicability across model types and inverse problems.

C2.justification: Interpretations of sampling trajectories and quality-efficiency tradeoffs remain unchanged, as do Appendix E's limitations concerning latent-space reconstruction, scheduling, fixed computational allocation, and biased priors.

D1.justification: Appendix F.3 newly states that DPnP's reported timing and results are taken from the cited paper, clarifying the provenance of an existing comparison. Other implementation details, hyperparameters, and code-access information are retained.

R1.justification: v3 adds Xu and Chi's 2024 DPnP paper as reference 57 and cites it in the background and baseline descriptions. The remaining reference-number shifts do not represent additional works.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited grammar, punctuation, and capitalization edits and corrects references from Section 4.2 to Figure 6 in the experimental discussion. Section organization and the overall narrative remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 2 adjusts spacing and diffusion-label colors. Figure 10 reformats the existing plots and adds noise-level labels to the color bars. All figures and tables are retained, with limited accompanying layout changes.

improvement.justification: v3 improves traceability by supplying the missing DPnP citation and explaining the source of its already plotted results in Appendix F.3. Corrected Figure 6 references and clearer figure labeling also help readers. These are limited documentation and presentation gains; the scientific methods, theory, and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
